summary: Frontend retest of the iter328 stale form bug (enterprise admin@maestroegp.com). All 3 requested items PASS. (1) Repro: in the all-projects view, Add printer > choose الشاورما > close > switch the bar to مطعم البرغر الملكي > reopen. There is no printer-project-select, the branch list shows only المنصور/الكرادة, and the POST has project_id=edc0531b (burger) with a burger branch, persisted in the DB. Add user, same repro: no user-project-select, the branch list shows burger branches, and POST /api/users sends project_id=burger, which saves. (2) In the burger view, edit-printer-project-select and edit-user-project-select are hidden. Saving PUTs the existing project_id=burger, so the project is kept. In the all-projects view both are shown, prefilled with the current project. (3) In the all-projects view, editing a printer from burger to الشاورما resets the branch to 'اختر الفرع', lists only the shawarma branches and saves project_id=shawarma. Adding a printer with مطعم الاختبار saves project_id=52aee398 and the main branch, and the project badges render. NEW MINOR ISSUE: a stale branch_id remains in the form.

ui_bugs.component: Add printer dialog (same pattern in Add user)
ui_bugs.issue: A stale branch_id remains in the form after a project switch. Steps: in the all-projects view choose الشاورما, pick the branch الجادرية, close, switch the bar to burger, reopen. The branch trigger shows EMPTY, but printerForm.branch_id is still ef8ab196 (shawarma). If the user saves without re-picking a branch, the POST sends the burger project with the shawarma branch, and the backend correctly returns 400 'الفرع المختار لا يتبع المشروع المحدد'. That is confusing, because the UI shows no branch selected. Fix: reset printerForm/userForm (project_id and branch_id) when selectedProjectId changes or when the dialog closes, or drop a branch_id that is not in branchesForProject(...) before submitting. The user form has the same pattern (verified by code reading; not reproduced in the UI).
